name: Being Vain
overview: Scripture warns against the emptiness of vain worship and false teachings that prioritize human traditions over God's truth, as seen in Matthew 15:9 and Matthew 7:15. True virtue and excellence are distinguished from mere outward appearances or vain pursuits, exemplified in Proverbs 31:29, which honors genuine godly character rather than superficial achievements. This study calls believers to discernment and sincere devotion rooted in Christ rather than in vain or deceptive practices.
